// Not a conformance case: the anti-tautology guard for the typecheck harness.
//
// A harness bug that reported "did not compile" unconditionally would make both real
// typecheck cases pass forever. This snippet is the same shape and MUST compile.
package main

import (
	"context"

	labelzoom "github.com/labelzoom/labelzoom-sdk/go"
)

func main() {
	client, _ := labelzoom.New()
	_, _ = client.Convert(context.Background(), labelzoom.ConvertRequest{
		From: labelzoom.SourceZPL,
		To:   labelzoom.TargetPDF,
		Body: []byte("^XA^XZ"),
	})
}
